versions.content: Describe variability of the hardware Type: valid Description: It shall be possible to describe the variability the actual hardware provides. Rationale: Most hardware is highly configurable, however there are restrictions and constraints on how the configuration can happen. Use Case: A pin of a controller can be either configured to be ADC or DIO. When the choice is done the other pins of that group are implicitly connected to the same peripheral.
